india-2016.notes: None of the eleven CodeChef pages names the contest or a letter; the match rests on the titles in CodeChef's 'ACM-ICPC Asia-India Finals Mirror Contest 2016' list (archived copy 20200623 of a page in this contest's folder), which lists eleven problems INF16A-L without G. Most pages give the author as an account (kol_adm or admin3).
